Turkish Chicken With Spiced Dates
Serves 4
Coat a large skillet with non-stick cooking spray.  Cook chicken over medium heat
about 5 minutes on each side or until chicken is no longer pink in the center.  Remove
chicken from skillet; cover and keep warm.
